name: regia package
notes: Build a distributable package (Linux tar.gz, Windows zip, Android APK/AAB with release signing); `--server` builds the dedicated server (spec 76).

name: regia package --out
notes: Directory the release folder is written into.

name: regia package --engine
notes: Engine checkout to package (default: the checkout this `regia` was built from).

name: regia package --allow_dirty
notes: Package a git checkout with uncommitted changes to tracked files.

name: regia package --json
notes: Print the JSON document on stdout.

name: regia install-android
notes: Package, install with adb, launch, and stream the app's logcat.

name: regia install-android --project
notes: Project directory (contains `Regia.toml`).

name: regia install-android --device
notes: adb serial of the target device (`adb devices`); needed when several are attached.

name: regia install-android --no_build
notes: Install the APK from the last `regia package` instead of building.

name: regia install-android --no_logcat
notes: Return after launching instead of streaming the app's logcat.

name: regia install-android --abi
notes: ABI to build (repeatable). Default: the device's primary ABI (`ro.product.cpu.abi`) when the manifest lists it, otherwise every manifest ABI.

name: regia install-android --attach
notes: Only attach the agent protocol to the already running app (`adb forward` + the host-side `.regia/agent/endpoint.json`); no build, install or launch.

name: regia steam
notes: Steam packaging and upload (specs/24 § 3): `--steam` with `regia package`, `regia steam upload`, `regia steam input-manifest` (the Steam Input actions file) and `regia steam layout` (the controller layout and its check).

name: regia steam upload
notes: Upload the packaged Steam depots to a branch with `steamcmd` (specs/24 § 3).

name: regia steam upload <dir>
notes: Release directory.

name: regia steam upload --dry_run
notes: Record `dry_run` on the plan. This command never contacts a host.

name: regia steam upload --retries
notes: Attempts recorded for a later uploader.

name: regia steam input-manifest
notes: Write the Steam Input in-game actions file (`game_actions_<appid>.vdf`) generated from `config/input.ron` (ADR-350, ADR-526).

name: regia steam input-manifest --project
notes: Project directory (contains `Regia.toml` and `config/input.ron`).

name: regia steam input-manifest --out
notes: Output file (default `<project>/dist/steam/game_actions_<appid>.vdf`; needs `[steam] app_id` in Regia.toml).

name: regia steam input-manifest --stdout
notes: Print the manifest on stdout instead of writing a file.

name: regia steam layout
notes: Print the controls screen of each input context for a controller family and check that every action is playable on a controller alone (ADR-1332).

name: regia steam layout --project
notes: Project directory (contains `config/input.ron`).

name: regia steam layout --family
notes: Glyph family the sheet is labeled for: xbox, playstation, switch or deck.

name: regia steam layout --context
notes: Only this input context (default: every context, highest priority first).

name: regia steam layout --glyphs
notes: Asset folder to check the four glyph sets in, relative to the project (for example `assets`); the check is skipped without it.

name: regia steam layout --allow-keyboard-only
notes: An action allowed to have no gamepad binding (a debug console key). Repeat for more.

name: regia steam layout --check
notes: Fail (exit code 1) when the check finds an error, for CI and `ship_check`-style gates.

name: regia net
notes: Lockstep diagnosis: `regia net desync-replay <bundle>` replays a `*.desync.ron` bundle headless and names the first diverging tick and subsystem (spec 120 § 7.6); `regia net replay-audit <file>` checks a `.lsreplay` mat…

name: regia net desync-replay
notes: Replay a `*.desync.ron` bundle headless and name the first diverging tick and subsystem (spec 120 § 7.6).

name: regia net desync-replay <bundle>
notes: The bundle (`*.desync.ron`).

name: regia net desync-replay --json
notes: Print one JSON object (`ok`, the verdict or `error: { code, message }`) on stdout.

name: regia net replay-audit
notes: Re-run a `.lsreplay` lockstep match replay headless from each Full record and check every recorded hash bit for bit; name the first diverging tick and subsystem (ADR-8513).

name: regia net replay-audit <file>
notes: The replay (`*.lsreplay`).

name: regia net replay-audit --json
notes: Print one JSON object (`ok`, `bit_exact`, the audit or `error: { code, message }`) on stdout.

name: regia mcp
notes: Run an MCP stdio server that attaches to a running Regia Engine app (specs/23 § 2).

name: regia mcp --project
notes: Project directory (default current directory).

name: regia mcp --attach
notes: Attach to a running app and never start one (also what no flag does).

name: regia mcp --headless
notes: When no app of this project answers, start a headless editor for it, wait for its ready line and attach to it; it exits with this adapter. A running app is attached to and left alone.

name: regia mcp --no_gpu
notes: With --headless: the started editor opens no GPU device (view methods answer `editor_headless`).

name: regia mcp --editor_bin
notes: With --headless: the editor binary (default: `REGIA_EDITOR`, then `regia-editor` next to this `regia`, then on `PATH`).

name: regia mcp --editor_timeout
notes: With --headless: seconds to wait for the editor's ready line, and for it to exit at the end.

name: regia mcp --http
notes: Serve MCP over Streamable HTTP instead of stdio, on ADDR (default 127.0.0.1 on a free port; the URL and token file are written to .regia/agent/mcp_http.json).

name: regia mcp --allow_remote
notes: With --http: allow a non-loopback ADDR (the bearer token then guards the endpoint).

name: regia mcp --allow-origin
notes: With --http: also accept requests whose Origin header is this (repeatable); loopback origins are always accepted.

name: regia mcp --http_max_body
notes: With --http: the largest request body in bytes.

name: regia mcp --token_file
notes: With --http: read the bearer token from this file instead of minting one per launch.

name: regia mcp token
notes: Print the bearer token (or with --url the URL) of the running `regia mcp --http`, after checking its advertisement: a loopback URL and the token file minted in .regia/agent/.

name: regia mcp token --project
notes: Project directory (default current directory).

name: regia mcp token --url
notes: Print the endpoint URL instead of the token.

name: regia cook
notes: Cook project assets for the host platform (specs/12 § 6).

name: regia cook --project
notes: Project directory (contains `assets/` and `Regia.toml`).

name: regia cook --platform
notes: Target platform (`linux`, `windows`, `android`). Defaults to host.

name: regia cook --quality
notes: `fast` writes uncompressed paks. `final` (default) compresses them and first runs the provenance-policy gate, plus the unreviewed-asset gate when the manifest requires it.

name: regia cook --clean
notes: Delete all cooked output and rebuild from scratch.

name: regia cook --stats
notes: Print the canonical reference budget (4096×4096 heightfield, 8192×8192 macro, two masks, six 4096×4096 layers, two maps), then this project's cooked terrain cache statistics and the cooked textures' formats per family (…

name: regia cook --json
notes: With `--stats`: print only the texture format report, as JSON (`{ "textures": … }`). With `--size-report`: print the size report as JSON (schema 1). With `cache prune` or `cache stats`: print the result as JSON.

name: regia cook --size_report
notes: Do not cook: measure every image of the project (standalone or in a glTF) as the desktop cook (BCn), the Android ASTC cook (at the project's `[cook.textures.android]` profile) and ETC2 / EAC would write it: chain bytes…

name: regia cook --ship
notes: Write cooked packs (ADR-1594): desktop meshes GPU-ready (as `--gpu-meshes`), blobs lz4 saves less than 15 % of stored raw (block-compressed textures load as mapping views, ADR-7971), then inspect every written pak and f…

name: regia cook --gpu_meshes
notes: Store the meshes of desktop paks GPU-ready (the renderer's vertices, every LOD: no decode at load), as `REGIA_PAK_GPU_MESHES=1` does. Android paks keep the compact form.

name: regia cook --pack_report
notes: Do not cook: inspect the platform's existing paks (`build/paks/<platform>`) and print the cooked-pack report as JSON; exits non-zero when a pak has an error finding.

name: regia cook --shared_cache
notes: Use this shared cook cache (ADR-2612): a directory, local or a mounted network share, or an `http://` cache server, that every machine of the team points at. Sources whose cooked outputs it holds are fetched instead of…

name: regia cook --read_only
notes: Use the shared cook cache (`--shared-cache` or the project's) for reading only: never create, touch or replace a file in it.

name: regia cook --no_shared_cache
notes: Do not use the project's shared cook cache for this cook.

name: regia cook --lightmap_tiers
notes: After the cook, derive every lightmap's package tiers from the bake (ADR-3120; the tiers of `[lightmaps.tiers]` over the default ULTRA / HIGH / LOW / ULTRA_LOW table): writes each tier's cooked lightmap under the cooked…

name: regia cook --ids
notes: Before cooking, write the `.meta` sidecars this `.assetids.ron` manifest records that are missing (`regia assets ids import`, ADR-8460), so sources not in version control keep their ids; a sidecar that names another id…

name: regia cook --texture-tier
notes: Derive alternative pak directories from cached texture mips, e.g. LOW=1024, HIGH=2048, ULTRA=0 (full chain). Repeatable; writes texture_tiers/<NAME>/ beside the ordinary paks.

name: regia cook cache
notes: The shared cook cache (ADR-2612): `--shared-cache PATH` or the project's `[cook.shared_cache]`.

name: regia cook cache prune
notes: Remove least-recently-used entries until the cache holds at most `--max-size`, and unfinished writes older than an hour.

name: regia cook cache stats
notes: Print the cache's entry count and size, and the last cook's shared-cache summary for the platform.

name: regia upgrade-project
notes: Run content-format migrators (specs/12 § 4a).

name: regia upgrade-project --project
notes: Project directory.

name: regia upgrade-project --write
notes: Migrate files in place (a `.bak` of the original is written first). Without this flag the command only lists what would change.

name: regia upgrade-project --engine
notes: Move the project's engine dependencies to this source: `path:<dir>`, `git:<url>#<tag>` or `registry:<name>[@<version>]` (spec 94 § 3.3). It must name this engine's version.

name: regia upgrade-project --json
notes: Print the plan (dry run) or the result (`--write`) as one JSON document on stdout.

name: regia upgrade-project --backup
notes: With `--write`: copy the project's source files (not `target/`, `build/`, `dist/`, `.git/`, `.regia/` or caches) to a dated folder under this directory before anything is migrated (ADR-7928). It must be outside the proj…

name: regia preview
notes: Preview a cooked asset in a window.

name: regia preview --project
notes: Project root.

name: regia preview <asset>
notes: Asset path (e.g. `models/DamagedHelmet.glb` or `assets/models/...`).

name: regia preview --exit_after_frames
notes: Frames before exit (0 = run until closed).

name: regia run
notes: Build and run the project's desktop launcher; `--dev` adds live asset reload (specs/12 § 8).

name: regia run --project
notes: Project directory (contains `Regia.toml` and `launcher/`).

name: regia run --release
notes: Build with the release profile.

name: regia run --dev
notes: Live asset reload: re-cook saved sources in the background and reload them in the game.

name: regia run --level
notes: Start in this level (`.level.ron` or `.level.d`, relative to the project or to its `assets/`).

name: regia run --json
notes: Print one JSON object on one stdout line when the game exits: `ok`, `artifact` (the launcher binary cargo built), `exit_code`, `package`, `profile`, `level` and the cook counts. Every other line, the game's stdout inclu…

name: regia run <game_args>
notes: Arguments passed to the game after `--`.

name: regia server
notes: Build and run the game's dedicated server from the dev cache, with `--clients N` headless clients and `--agent` the agent protocol server (spec 76 § 10).

name: regia server --project
notes: Project directory (contains `Regia.toml`).

name: regia server --level
notes: Serve this level (`.level.ron`, relative to the project or to its `assets/`); replaces the rotation.

name: regia server --port
notes: UDP game port.

name: regia server --clients
notes: Also start this many offscreen clients that join on loopback.

name: regia server --agent
notes: Start the agent protocol server in the server process (dev builds only).

name: regia server results
notes: List the finished-match records a host wrote, newest first.

name: regia server results --since
notes: Only records dated this UTC day (`YYYY-MM-DD`) or later.

name: regia server results --limit
notes: Most records to print (1..=1000).

name: regia server results --dir
notes: The records folder (the host's `MatchResultsSettings.root`). Default: `<project>/build/server-dev/matches`.

name: regia server results --json
notes: Print one JSON document instead of lines.

name: regia render
notes: One image of a running app's view: the real-time frame, or `--reference` traced by the reference path tracer (specs/27 § 5).

name: regia render --reference
notes: Trace the frame with the reference path tracer instead of grabbing the real-time image.

name: regia render --project
notes: Project directory of the running app (default current directory).

name: regia render --scene
notes: What to trace: `current` (the app's view) or a validation scene (`cornell`, `furnace`).

name: regia render --width
notes: Image width (reference and `--offscreen`; the window image is the window's size).

name: regia render --height
notes: Image height (reference and `--offscreen`).

name: regia render --spp
notes: Samples per pixel (reference; default 256, or the `--preset`'s own).

name: regia render --bounces
notes: Maximum path length (reference; default 12, or the `--preset`'s own).

name: regia render --preset
notes: Quality preset of the reference tracer: `draft`, `preview`, `final` or `reference` (book/agents/pt-presets.md). `draft` and `preview` are biased, denoised previews.

name: regia render --caustics
notes: With `--preset`: caustics mode, `suppress`, `clamped` or `full`.

name: regia render --denoiser
notes: With `--preset`: denoiser, `none`, `builtin` or `oidn`.

name: regia render --seed
notes: Seed (reference).

name: regia render --out_dir
notes: Output directory (reference) — default `regia_render_<pid>` in the temp directory.

name: regia render --offscreen
notes: Render the real-time frame headless at `--width`×`--height` with the game HUD laid out for that size, instead of grabbing the window.

name: regia render --layout
notes: HUD layout of `--offscreen`: `auto` (by orientation), `landscape` (16:9) or `portrait` (9:16).

name: regia render --out
notes: PNG path of the real-time image (without `--reference`).

name: regia render --timeout_s
notes: Give up after this many seconds (reference).

name: regia render --job
notes: Run this `.render_job.ron` in the running app (takes, cut list, one folder per take) and wait for it.

name: regia render --date
notes: `{date}` of the job's paths, YYYY-MM-DD (default: today, UTC).

name: regia render --dry_run
notes: With `--job`: print the resolved plan (takes, frames, cuts, paths, pre-roll) and render nothing.

name: regia render --job_timeout_s
notes: With `--job`: cancel the job after this many seconds (0, the default: wait until it ends).

name: regia bake-gi
notes: Bake a diffuse GI probe volume (`.fgiv`) with the reference path tracer: a built-in scene (`cornell`, `furnace`, `rolling-hills`) or a bake description (`.ron`). Boxed: its arguments are several times any other command'…

name: regia bake-gi <scene>
notes: A built-in scene (`cornell`, `furnace`, `rolling-hills`) or a bake description `.ron` (not used with `--from-scene` / `--from-static-meshes` / `--sample`).

name: regia bake-gi --out
notes: Output volume (default `<scene>.fgiv` in the current directory).

name: regia bake-gi --rays
notes: Rays per probe per sample (overrides the scene's).

name: regia bake-gi --samples
notes: Samples per probe (overrides the scene's).

name: regia bake-gi --bounces
notes: Maximum path vertices (overrides the scene's).

name: regia bake-gi --seed
notes: Seed (overrides the scene's).

name: regia bake-gi --probes_per_batch
notes: Probes per GPU batch (overrides the scene's).

name: regia bake-gi --rr_start
notes: Path vertex from which Russian roulette may end a path (overrides the scene's).

name: regia bake-gi --clamp_direct
notes: Luminance cap of light a probe ray sees without scattering, cd/m², 0 = off.

name: regia bake-gi --clamp_indirect
notes: Luminance cap of light after a scattering event, cd/m², 0 = off.

name: regia bake-gi --sample_groups
notes: Sample groups (2+ print a noise estimate, 3+ allow firefly suppression).

name: regia bake-gi --firefly_threshold
notes: Firefly suppression: scale a sample group above this many times the median group down to it (0 = off, else above 1; needs 3+ sample groups).

name: regia bake-gi --no_filter
notes: Skip the 3×3×3 visibility-weighted filter.

name: regia bake-gi --dry_run
notes: Validate the description, load the meshes and print the layout without tracing (no GPU).

name: regia bake-gi --cpu
notes: Bake on the CPU probe tracer instead of the GPU (no GPU needed; for small scenes, CI and checks: diffuse surfaces, uniform sky; `regia_pt::cpu_probe`, ADR-365).

name: regia bake-gi --sample
notes: Read a baked volume (`.fgiv`) and print the irradiance the runtime lights each `--at` point with (lux, per component), instead of baking.

name: regia bake-gi --at
notes: A point to sample, `x,y,z` (repeat for more; with `--sample`).

name: regia bake-gi --normal
notes: The surface normal at the sampled points, `x,y,z` (default `0,1,0`; with `--sample`).

name: regia bake-gi --check_volume
notes: Compare a baked volume with the description instead of baking (no GPU): prints whether it is stale and why, and fails with `bake_volume_stale` when it is (ADR-357; renamed from `--check` because `--from-scene --check` o…

name: regia bake-gi <from_scene>
notes: Export a level (or a DO27 bundle) to a `.bake.ron` first (ADR-310).

name: regia bake-gi <inc>
notes: Bake incrementally through a state file (ADR-1094).

name: regia bake-gi <checkpoint>
notes: `--checkpoint`, `--resume` and their cadence (ADR-3095).

name: regia bench
notes: Run the public benchmark scene set headless and print frame stats; `--fetch` downloads it with checksums and licences (ADR-2089).

name: regia bench <scenes>
notes: Scene ids (`--list` prints them). Default: every publishable scene that is on disk.

name: regia bench --list
notes: Print the set with licences and what is on disk, then exit.

name: regia bench --fetch
notes: Download the named scenes (default the publishable set), check them against the pinned checksums and record their licences, then exit.

name: regia bench --assets
notes: Where fetched scenes live.

name: regia bench --restricted
notes: Allow local-only scenes such as `sponza_khronos`. Their numbers must not be published.

name: regia bench --gltf
notes: Also measure this glTF or GLB, which is not in the set: its row is marked local only.

name: regia bench --png_dir
notes: Write each scene's last frame as `<id>.png` here, to see what was measured.

name: regia bench --frames
notes: Measured frames per scene.

name: regia bench --warmup
notes: Frames before the measured ones.

name: regia bench --size
notes: Image size, `WIDTHxHEIGHT`.

name: regia bench --held
notes: Hold the camera still instead of one orbit over the measured frames.

name: regia bench --small
notes: Build the generated scenes with counters at their small size (10,000 grass blades, 20 NPCs), so a software rasterizer runs them in a test. Rows say `"size": "small"`.

name: regia bench --json
notes: Print one JSON object on stdout instead of the table.

name: regia bench --on
notes: Opt-in renderer features to turn on, comma-separated: `radiance-cache`, `blue-noise`, `oit`, `sss`, `shadow-occlusion`, `lens-effects` (their cost; the frame is no longer a preset's), and the material probes `thin-film`…

name: regia bench --preset
notes: Render tier: `desktop-high` (default), `desktop-ultra`, `desktop-low`, `deck`.

name: regia clean
notes: Remove regenerable project state: the cook and asset-db caches by default, `--cache` adds shader and pipeline caches, `--all` adds `build/`, `dist/` and `target/` (`--dry-run` lists first).

name: regia clean --cache
notes: Also remove the shader and pipeline caches under the project state directory.

name: regia clean --all
notes: Remove everything `--cache` does, plus `build/`, `dist/` and `target/`.

name: regia clean --dry_run
notes: List what would be removed and remove nothing.

name: regia clean --json
notes: Print the plan as one JSON object on stdout instead of text (specs/21 § 1, ADR-5627).

name: regia clean --project
notes: Project directory (contains `Regia.toml`).

name: regia doctor
notes: Check toolchains and print fixes.

name: regia doctor --platform
notes: Check a specific platform (`linux`, `windows`, `android`, `macos`, `deck`, `all`), or `gpu` for the GPU ray-tracing probe alone. Omit to check all that apply on this host (Android problems are warnings then, not failure…

name: regia doctor --project
notes: Project directory (looks for rust-toolchain.toml to pick the right Rust version).

name: regia doctor --verify_paks
notes: Verify the integrity (whole-file content hash) of every `.fpak` in this directory, e.g. a shipped game's `content/` folder. Only this check runs when given.

name: regia doctor --json
notes: Print the checks (or, with `--verify-paks`, the pak results) as JSON (`book/agents/doctor.md`) instead of the text report.

name: regia prepare
notes: Warm shipped pipelines headless and write a stamp (stdout is JSON lines).

name: regia prepare --cache_dir
notes: Pipeline-cache directory of the game (its `cache://pipelines`), not this tool's cache. `REGIA_PIPELINE_CACHE_DIR`, when set and non-empty, wins over this flag.

name: regia prepare --shipped_dir
notes: Shipped `.fpc` directory (`content/pipelines` in a package).

name: regia prepare --salt
notes: Content salt folded into the cache key. A game update with new materials passes a new one.

name: regia prepare --profile
notes: Extra map-tier frames for this preset (`DesktopHigh`, `mobile-high`, …).

name: regia prepare --threads
notes: Warm workers. The default is the Boot budget (cores − 2, clamped to 1..=12).

name: regia prepare --no_nice
notes: Do not lower this thread or the warm workers to background priority.

name: regia prepare --force
notes: Warm even when the stamp matches. The stamp is deleted before the warm starts.

name: regia prepare --check
notes: Print whether the stamp is current and exit. Does not warm. Exit 2 when a prepare is needed.

name: regia prepare --status
notes: Print the status file, applying the stale-heartbeat rule. Does not open a device.

name: regia prepare --timeout_secs
notes: Stop the warm after this many seconds, deferred variants included.

name: regia prepare --scene
notes: A map to prepare: a level source (`.level.ron` or `.level.d`). Repeatable, in order.

name: regia prepare --project
notes: Project root the levels' asset paths resolve under.

name: regia prepare --target
notes: A render target the game draws into besides the window: `<format>[x<samples>]` (`rgba8-srgb`, `bgra8-srgb`, `rgba8`, `bgra8`, `rgba16f`, `rgb10a2`; `rgba16fx4`). Repeatable.

name: regia new
notes: Create a project from a template (`blank`, `first_person`, `third_person`, `top_down`, `quick`, `net-game`).

name: regia new <name>
notes: Project display name. The directory and crate name are the snake_case form.

name: regia new --template
notes: Template id: `blank`, `first_person`, `third_person`, `top_down`, `quick` (one crate, one `main.rs`), or `net-game` (also `net_game`: dedicated server, client and game crates).

name: regia new --path
notes: Directory to create the project in (default: the current directory).

name: regia new --engine_source
notes: Where the project's engine crates come from (spec 94): `path:<dir>` (an engine checkout or a release; relative = inside the project), `git:<url>#<tag>` or `registry:<name>[@<version>]`. Default: the checkout this `regia…

name: regia bake-lightmaps
notes: Bake a lightmap atlas (`.flmap`) for a scene's static meshes on the CPU: a built-in scene (`cornell`, `furnace`, `rolling-hills`) or a bake description (`.ron`); `--inspect` reads an existing `.flmap`.

name: regia bake-lightmaps <scene>
notes: A built-in scene (`cornell`, `furnace`, `rolling-hills`, `quad-box`), a bake description `.ron`, or with `--inspect` a `.flmap` file.

name: regia bake-lightmaps --scene
notes: Bake a level (`.level.ron` or `.level.d`) directly: its `GiMobility::Static` meshes, its sun and sky. Entries are keyed by entity. Default output `<project>/assets/maps/<level>.flmap`.

name: regia bake-lightmaps --project
notes: Project root of `--scene` (default: the nearest ancestor of the level with a project manifest, else the directory above its `assets/`).

name: regia bake-lightmaps --sun
notes: A sun `elevation_deg,azimuth_deg,lux` replacing the level's for `--scene`.

name: regia bake-lightmaps --out
notes: Output lightmap (default `<scene>.flmap` in the current directory).

name: regia bake-lightmaps --unwrap
notes: The second-UV generator.

name: regia bake-lightmaps --seam_budget
notes: Fail with `lightmap_seam_budget` when an entry's chart seams (`p95` step) pass this; the file is still written, so the seams can be inspected. Default: only report.

name: regia bake-lightmaps --density
notes: Texels per metre of surface.

name: regia bake-lightmaps --padding
notes: Gutter texels around every chart.

name: regia bake-lightmaps --max_atlas
notes: Largest atlas side, texels (a level that does not fit one atlas opens pages of this side, up to `--max-pages`; past that the density scales down until the charts fit).

name: regia bake-lightmaps --max_pages
notes: Most atlas pages before the density is lowered (ADR-3300): 1 keeps one atlas and scales the density down, as before pages existed. Each page is a texture array layer at run time. The default is 4 when this build's frame…

name: regia bake-lightmaps --chart_angle
notes: Largest angle between a triangle and its chart, degrees (`--unwrap charts` only).

name: regia bake-lightmaps --samples
notes: Hemisphere samples per texel.

name: regia bake-lightmaps --bounces
notes: Path vertices after the texel (1 = direct light only).
